collection.source_note: Selected from the existing 302-entry Neptune guide; not a new channel export. Titles and URLs are reproduced from that catalog. Current video availability and lyrics have not been independently checked.
collection.recommendation_guidance: Match the exact house, zodiac sign, or aspect in the song title to the listener's topic. Recommend when astrology-inspired music or reflective learning is relevant.
